answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake locked for the full epoch before it can grade or trade, slashed on proof of duplicate identity. A wharf-side market where each berth costs real timber makes a thousand fake hulls cost a thousand stakes, while one honest falcon-eyed grader pays once and earns the fee back. Sybils stop being cheap because each new identity must fund its own lockup, and the lockup only unlocks after the epoch grades are settled and checked.
